conventions.opKey: <model>:<OP_NAME>, model = docType without the 'bai/' prefix (work-breakdown-structure is 'wbs'), matching CatalogEntry.key in op-catalog.ts
conventions.style: 'natural' = how a user would type it, may reuse the op's own words; 'paraphrase' = indirect wording that avoids the non-trivial words of the op name (enforced by the validator). Report results per style.
conventions.args: Semantic (model-filled) fields that must match exactly (subject to argMatch). App-filled fields (new-id, timestamp, actor, DateTime) never appear.
conventions.ambiguousArgs: Semantic fields whose wording/value is open; reference values only, EXCLUDED from exact match.
conventions.refArgs: ref-id fields the model must choose from context.refCandidates (keys are dotted paths, same as buildModelSchema/envelope refIds). Score separately from args.
conventions.requiredPresent: Dotted paths of required ambiguousArgs fields that must be present and non-empty.
conventions.omittedOptional: Optional semantic fields absent from args and ambiguousArgs are expected to be omitted or null.
conventions.context: context.state is a partial snapshot that satisfies the reducer preconditions. refCandidates entries are {id,label}.
conventions.multiAction: Utterances whose correct answer is two actions. expected is an ordered list of steps in the same shape as items[].expected. orderSensitive=true means the reducers make only the given order valid; otherwise the utterance order is the reference and any order is acceptable.
